# Staging: S3

Used when `stage.mode` is `s3`.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| `stage.s3.access-key`<br>`CRIER_STAGE_S3_ACCESS_KEY`<br>`--stage-s3-access-key` | string | — | S3 access key id **Secret**: redacted by `crier config`. |
| `stage.s3.acl`<br>`CRIER_STAGE_S3_ACL`<br>`--stage-s3-acl` | string | — | canned ACL applied to the object, e.g. "public-read" |
| `stage.s3.bucket`<br>`CRIER_STAGE_S3_BUCKET`<br>`--stage-s3-bucket` | string | — | S3 bucket the image is uploaded to |
| `stage.s3.delete-after`<br>`CRIER_STAGE_S3_DELETE_AFTER`<br>`--stage-s3-delete-after` | bool | `true` | delete the staged object once publishing is done |
| `stage.s3.endpoint`<br>`CRIER_STAGE_S3_ENDPOINT`<br>`--stage-s3-endpoint` | string | — | S3-compatible endpoint host, e.g. s3.amazonaws.com or localhost:9000 |
| `stage.s3.prefix`<br>`CRIER_STAGE_S3_PREFIX`<br>`--stage-s3-prefix` | string | — | key prefix inside the bucket |
| `stage.s3.presign`<br>`CRIER_STAGE_S3_PRESIGN`<br>`--stage-s3-presign` | bool | `true` | hand out a presigned URL instead of a public one |
| `stage.s3.presign-expiry`<br>`CRIER_STAGE_S3_PRESIGN_EXPIRY`<br>`--stage-s3-presign-expiry` | duration | `1h` | lifetime of the presigned URL |
| `stage.s3.public-base-url`<br>`CRIER_STAGE_S3_PUBLIC_BASE_URL`<br>`--stage-s3-public-base-url` | string | — | base URL objects are publicly reachable at, when presign is false |
| `stage.s3.region`<br>`CRIER_STAGE_S3_REGION`<br>`--stage-s3-region` | string | `us-east-1` | S3 region |
| `stage.s3.secret-key`<br>`CRIER_STAGE_S3_SECRET_KEY`<br>`--stage-s3-secret-key` | string | — | S3 secret access key **Secret**: redacted by `crier config`. |
| `stage.s3.use-ssl`<br>`CRIER_STAGE_S3_USE_SSL`<br>`--stage-s3-use-ssl` | bool | `true` | talk to the S3 endpoint over HTTPS |

A sample carrying every key with its default is at
[`crier.example.yaml`](../../../crier.example.yaml).
